name: M142 HIMARS (FMTV 6x6 with the armoured LSAC cab and one six-rocket pod); js/hero/us_m270_himars.js, HeroUsMlrs, also nato_e00_tel and tel_n

published.source: en.wikipedia 'M142 HIMARS' infobox / Lockheed Martin: 7.0 x 2.4 x 3.2 m; 395/85R20 tyres (1.18 m). The model's X extent is 7.08 m (bumper guards to the tail pintle); UNIT_MODELS len 7.08 for all three HIMARS rows; launcher3d_check holds the stowed height <= 3.205 m.

engine_contract.rows: nato_e00_mlrs (turret:true, 6 cells), nato_e00_tel (turret:false, 1 ATACMS cell), tel_n (turret:false, 2 PrSM cells); the NMESIS and Excalibur rows of eras.js borrow tel_n by modelAs
engine_contract.nodes: 'turret' (module group, x -1.60, z 1.22; unnamed on the turret:false rows) holding 'podelev' (userData.el 35 deg, cells); six 'roadwheel' groups, one a tyre; ord on the UNIT_MODELS entry

references.name: [D] HIMARS.png, side drawing (port side, nose left), 500 px thumbnail
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'HIMARS.png' (737 x 275; the 500 px Commons thumbnail is used: the original was rate-limited)
references.note: THE STATION DRAWING. Scale: bumper front x 2 to the tail x 495 = 493 px = the published 7.0 m, 70.4 px/m; ground y 186. Horizontal stations (trusted): front axle x 85 -> +2.36 m, middle axle x 308 -> -0.83, rear axle x 401 -> -2.16 (tandem 1.33 m apart); the cab's rear wall x 124 -> +1.81; the cab front vertical at x 5.5 -> +3.49 from mid height down, raked back above to x 19 -> +3.30 at the roof; the box behind the cab +1.23..+0.59; the module's main box x 235..488 -> +0.23..-3.37; the stowed boom on the module's top x 303..403 -> -0.74..-2.15, its raised head toward the cab. VERTICALLY the drawing is squashed: its cab roof reads 2.60 m and its module top 2.24 m against 2.96 and 2.57 measured on [SG] with the tyre as yardstick (about 0.88 of true), so heights are not taken from it and the outline is advisory only.

references.name: [SG] 21651MID The Singapore Army HIMARS, port front quarter
references.source: Wikimedia Commons '21651MID The Singapore Army The High Mobility Artillery Rocket System HIMARS.jpg', 1280 px thumb
references.note: THE HEIGHT PHOTO and the cab front. With the near tyre (1.18 m, 185 px) as yardstick: cab roof over the front axle 2.96 m; with the rear tyre (160 px): module top 2.57 m, module box bottom 1.54 m. The armoured cab: two small windscreens in heavy frames in the raked upper front; a horizontal crease under them; the lower front a big faceted plate tucked in toward the bottom, the grille of horizontal slots low in it; the wide bumper with the round headlamps and amber lamps, a louvred skid plate under it; five amber marker lamps on the roof's front edge; the chamfered front corners; the side window and the door; the mirrors on arms. Wears a registration plate and a flag: not drawn.

references.name: [HS18] 180614-A-IY962-102, HIMARS firing, port front quarter
references.source: Wikimedia Commons '180614-A-IY962-102 - M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) firing during Saber Strike 18 (Image 4 of 7).jpg' (US Army), 1280 px thumb
references.note: The cab's port side and front corner: framed windscreens, the louvred grille on the chamfered corner, the door's hinges and long grab handle, bolt rows, bumper lamps, steps, the front mudguard.

references.name: [AS] HIMARS 668579 EMILY ROSE, starboard front quarter at an air show
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket System (HIMARS) 668579 EMILY ROSE (14992404654).jpg', 1280 px thumb
references.note: The cab front from the starboard side: the faceted lower front with its grille, the bumper and lamps, the windscreens; the boxes behind the cab on the starboard side. Has nose art and numbers: not drawn.

must_show: three axles: the front at x +2.36, the tandem close-coupled at x -0.83 and -2.16 (1.33 m apart), big lugged 1.18 m tyres ([D] side)
the armoured cab from x +1.81 to the front, roof z 2.96 ([SG]); flat sides, big chamfered front corners

the cab front: two small windscreens in heavy armoured frames in the raked upper face (from x 3.30 at the roof to x 3.49 at z 2.2), a centre pillar between them, wipers; a crease across under them; the lower front plate tucked in toward the bottom with the louvred grille low in it (z 1.3-1.65) ([SG][D][AS])
the wide bumper across the front (x 3.36..3.52, z 0.78..1.08) with the round headlamps and amber lamps, guards, tow shackles, the louvred skid plate under it ([SG][HS18])

five amber marker lamps on the roof's front edge (x 3.0, z 2.96..3.03), the mirrors on their arms at the front corners (z 2.4..2.8), the door with hinges, grab handle and the small high side window (x 2.55..2.95, z 2.31..2.69) ([SG][HS18])
behind the cab on the port side the intake tower (x 1.40..1.74, to z 2.96) and the box (x 0.55..1.30); on the starboard side the locker ([D][SG])
the module over the tandem, x -3.39..+0.20, box bottom z 1.54, top 2.57-2.60, three access panels a side, the stowed boom lying on its top with its raised head ([D][SG])
one pod face of 3 x 2 tube mouths in the module's end face, elevating to 35 deg about the trunnion at the other end (engine)
not_confirmed: POD FACE FORWARD: on the real truck the pod face travels AFT over the tail ([D] and the rear views on Commons); the engine raises the +X end of 'podelev', so the module, its boom and panels are drawn mirrored (traversed 180 degrees), as before
heights read off the quarter photograph [SG] with a tyre as the yardstick (+-0.08 m); the drawing [D] is squashed vertically
the published 3.2 m height: the model's highest point is the roof hatch / boom at about 3.08 m
the cab's plan (the chamfer widths at the front corners) is read off the quarter photographs, not measured on a plan
the stowage behind the cab (a tarpaulin and two water cans) and the mirror head size
the underside and the chassis between the frame rails
